title: Shein flags tariff hits after posting quarterly loss ahead of Hong Kong IPO
summary: Shein, the fast-fashion retailer, has reported a quarterly loss and is warning about tariff impacts as it prepares for its Hong Kong listing, which received approval from China on July 10. The company is proceeding with its Hong Kong IPO after failed attempts to list in New York and London.
content: The retailer won approval ‌from China for its Hong Kong ​listing on July 10, clearing the way for a listing after failed attempts in New ⁠York and London.

zh.title: Shein报告季度亏损,警告关税冲击,准备香港IPO
zh.summary: 快时尚零售商Shein报告季度亏损,并就关税冲击发出警告,为香港上市做准备。该计划已于7月10日获中国批准。在纽约和伦敦上市失败后,公司继续推进香港IPO。

title: For Gen X investors, dotcom bubble haunts stock market portfolios closing in on retirement
summary: Gen X investors aged 50-55, with approximately 10-15 years until retirement, face concerns about market timing risks as they continue building retirement savings through 401(k)s and IRAs. The experience of the dotcom crash weighs on their investment decisions as they approach retirement.
content: Many Americans in the 50-55 age range have 10 to 15 work years left, extending 401(k), IRA growth investing, but they can't afford an ill-timed market crash.

zh.title: 互联网泡沫困扰X一代投资者在退休前的股票投资组合
zh.summary: 年龄50-55岁的X一代投资者距退休约10-15年,在继续通过401(k)和IRA积累退休储蓄时,面临市场择时风险担忧。互联网泡沫崩溃的经历影响了他们接近退休时的投资决策。

title: Inside the S&P 500 AI boom, industrials are getting as rich as tech stocks
summary: The industrials sector is benefiting from the AI infrastructure boom, with its price-to-earnings ratio climbing to levels comparable with technology stocks, reflecting strong investor interest. This shift shows how AI-driven growth is spreading beyond traditional tech companies.
content: The industrials sector of the stock market is benefitting from the AI infrastructure boom with its P/E ratio up close to tech levels and investor flows strong.

zh.title: 在标普500指数AI热潮中,工业股估值赶上科技股
zh.summary: 工业部门从AI基础设施热潮中获益,市盈率上升至与科技股相当的水平,反映出投资者的强劲兴趣。这一转变表明,AI驱动的增长正扩展到传统科技公司之外。

title: How AI wealth could be distributed to all Americans
summary: While AI wealth remains concentrated among a handful of powerful companies, policymakers and economists are exploring various approaches to more broadly distribute AI-generated riches across the population. The proposals range from traditional to more radical solutions for sharing AI benefits.
content: AI riches are already concentrated among a handful of powerful companies, but there are plenty of new, some radical, ideas about how to spread the wealth.

zh.title: 人工智能财富如何分配给所有美国人
zh.summary: 尽管人工智能财富目前集中在少数强大的公司手中，政策制定者和经济学家正在探索各种方法，将AI创造的财富更广泛地分配给全体民众。这些提案范围涵盖从传统到更激进的AI利益分享解决方案。

title: The S&P 500’s earnings growth has gone bonkers thanks to one company
summary: The S&P 500's earnings growth has been significantly boosted by a single dominant company during earnings season. Markets are entering the busiest period of second-quarter earnings announcements.
content: Markets are gearing up for the busiest week of second-quarter earnings season.

zh.title: 标普500指数的盈利增长因一家公司而激增
zh.summary: 在财报季期间，标普500指数的盈利增长得到了一家主导公司的显著提升。市场正进入第二季度财报公布最繁忙的时期。

title: Some high-earning investors will soon owe taxes on years of deferred capital gains
summary: Opportunity Zone investors who have been deferring taxes on reinvested capital gains will lose this benefit at the end of 2026, forcing them to settle their tax obligations. This change will affect high-earning investors who have utilized this tax incentive.
content: A key incentive in place for current Opportunity Zone investors — deferring taxation of reinvested capital gains — will end on Dec. 31.

zh.title: 一些高收入投资者即将为多年的递延资本收益缴税
zh.summary: 通过机遇区延税的资本收益投资者将在2026年底失去此优惠，被迫结清其税务义务。这一变化将影响已利用此税收激励的高收入投资者。

title: 4 generations, 6 different visions of the American Dream: 'I'm optimistic because of our resilience'
summary: CNBC surveyed notable voices across politics, finance, and relationships to explore how different generations define and pursue the American Dream in today's economy. The article reflects diverse perspectives on achieving happiness and success in modern America.
content: CNBC Make It asked notable voices in politics, finance and relationships on what it takes to achieve happiness and success in America today.

zh.title: 4代人，6种对美国梦的不同愿景：'我对我们的韧性感到乐观'
zh.summary: CNBC调查了来自政治、金融和人际关系领域的知名人士，以探讨不同世代在当今经济中如何定义和追求美国梦。该文章反映了关于在现代美国实现幸福和成功的多种观点。

title: Vehicle mows down crowd at Berlin Pride festival, killing one
summary: A vehicle struck multiple people at Berlin Pride festival in Tiergarten park near the Brandenburg Gate, killing at least one person. The incident occurred during a large public gathering at a major German landmark. Police are investigating the attack.
content: German police say the vehicle struck multiple people after charging into the city's central Tiergarten park close to the Brandenburg Gate.

zh.title: 车辆冲入柏林骄傲节人群，至少一人丧生
zh.summary: 一辆车在勃兰登堡门附近的蒂尔加滕公园柏林骄傲节上撞伤多人，至少造成一人死亡。该事件发生在德国主要地标的大型公众集会期间。警方正在调查此次袭击事件。

title: Ukraine strikes Iranian vessels in Caspian Sea, Tehran accuses Kyiv of 'hostile and criminal act'
summary: Ukraine conducted strikes against Iranian vessels in the Caspian Sea, with Iran condemning the action as hostile. Combined with Saudi strikes on Iran-backed forces in Yemen, the incidents signal broader regional military escalation. The attacks represent a widening of Middle East conflicts involving multiple actors.
content: The latest attacks by Ukraine, combined with Saudi military strikes on Iran-backed Houthi targets in Yemen, represent a widening of the Middle East conflict.

zh.title: 乌克兰在里海攻击伊朗舰船，伊朗指责基辅"敌对和犯罪行为"
zh.summary: 乌克兰在里海对伊朗船只进行了打击，伊朗谴责这一行为具有敌意。结合沙特对也门伊朗支持势力的打击，这些事件预示着更广泛的地区军事升级。这些攻击代表了中东冲突的扩大，涉及多方参与者。

title: Water supply issue affects Gatwick Airport
summary: Gatwick Airport is experiencing a water supply disruption requiring bottled water distribution to passengers and staff. The airport remains operational while authorities investigate the source of the problem. The incident highlights critical infrastructure vulnerabilities at major transportation hubs.
content: Bottled water is being handed out to passengers and staff while the issue is investigated.

zh.title: 供水问题影响盖特威克机场
zh.summary: 盖特威克机场正在经历供水中断，需要向乘客和工作人员分配瓶装水。机场在当局调查问题根源期间继续运营。该事件突显了大型交通枢纽的关键基础设施脆弱性。

title: There’s a technical ‘triple threat’ for stocks, but also places investors can hide
summary: Rising Treasury yields, surging oil prices, and dollar strength have combined to push the S&P 500 below key technical support levels. These three converging factors create significant headwinds for equity markets. Selective sectors and investments may offer protection during this volatility.
content: Treasury yields and oil prices surged, and the dollar confirmed the breakout toward a longer-term uptrend, to push the S&P 500 below key chart support.

zh.title: 股票面临技术性"三重威胁"，但投资者也有避险之地
zh.summary: 国债收益率上升、油价飙升和美元升值的结合导致标普500指数跌破关键技术支撑位。这三个相互融合的因素为股票市场造成重大阻力。精选板块和投资可能会在这次波动中提供保护。

title: The Treasury market is sending Fed Chair Kevin Warsh a clear warning about rates
summary: Rising Treasury yields signal widespread market concerns about inflation and doubts over whether the Federal Reserve will maintain its hawkish stance. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh is receiving clear signals from bond markets about investor anxiety regarding interest rates. The market's caution reflects uncertainty about future Fed policy direction.
content: Rising Treasury yields show how “enormously worried” the market is about inflation — and whether the Fed will back up its tough talk with action

zh.title: 国债市场向美联储主席凯文·沃什发出关于利率的明确警告
zh.summary: 国债收益率上升表明市场对通货膨胀的广泛关注，以及对美联储是否会维持其鹰派立场的怀疑。美联储主席凯文·沃什从债券市场获得了关于投资者利率焦虑的明确信号。市场的谨慎反映了对美联储未来政策走向的不确定性。

title: New UK Prime Minister Burnham says he would be prepared to call out Trump
summary: UK Prime Minister Burnham, in his first conversation with President Trump, expressed willingness to publicly challenge Trump when necessary. The two leaders discussed matters during a call Burnham described as constructive. The statement signals the new UK leader's intent to maintain independent diplomatic positions.
content: Burnham said he had a phone conversation with Trump on Monday when he officially took on the role, describing it as "a good exchange".

zh.title: 英国新首相伯纳姆表示准备好挑战特朗普
zh.summary: 英国首相伯纳姆在与特朗普总统的首次交谈中表示，愿意在必要时公开挑战特朗普。两位领导人在伯纳姆称之为建设性的通话中讨论了相关事项。这一声明表明这位英国新领导人的意图是维持独立的外交立场。

title: When to claim Social Security — and how to build the rest of your retirement income
summary: Social Security benefits can be claimed as early as age 62, but delaying benefits provides significant financial advantages for retirees. The timing decision has substantial long-term implications for retirement income strategy and wealth accumulation. Financial planning should balance personal circumstances with reduced early benefits versus increased delayed payments.
content: You can start collecting Social Security benefits at age 62, but there's a real upside to waiting.

zh.title: 何时领取社会保障金 — 以及如何构建退休收入的其余部分
zh.summary: 社会保障金可以从62岁起就开始领取，但延迟领取福利对退休者来说具有显著的经济优势。领取时间决定对退休收入策略和财富积累具有重大的长期影响。财务规划应平衡个人情况与早期领取较少福利与延迟领取增加福利之间的权衡。

title: 100 days until midterm election: DCCC Chair DelBene says Democrats have the momentum
summary: With 100 days until midterm elections, Democratic officials believe they have momentum to reclaim House control as Trump's approval ratings decline. The Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee sees a viable pathway to majority given current political conditions. Sustained voter engagement and stable polling trends will be critical to the outcome.
content: Democrats see a path back to the U.S. House majority this November as President Donald Trump's approval dips.

zh.title: 距中期选举100天：民主党全国委员会主席DelBene表示民主党势头强劲
zh.summary: 距中期选举还有100天，民主党官员相信他们有势头在特朗普支持率下降的情况下夺回众议院控制权。民主党全国委员会认为在当前政治条件下有切实可行的多数派途径。持续的选民参与和稳定的民调趋势将对结果至关重要。

title: What more expensive corporate debt could mean for the AI buildout
summary: Rising corporate debt costs and wider credit spreads pose challenges for the capital-intensive AI sector, particularly for heavily leveraged tech companies. Increased borrowing expenses could slow investment in AI infrastructure and development projects. Companies with significant debt burdens may face pressure to reassess expansion plans.
content: Wider credit spreads are coming, and they will pressurize heavily indebted segments of the tech sector.

zh.title: 更昂贵的公司债务对人工智能建设意味着什么
zh.summary: 上升的公司债务成本和更广泛的信用利差对资本密集型人工智能部门构成挑战，特别是对高杠杆的科技公司。增加的借款费用可能会减缓对人工智能基础设施和开发项目的投资。债务负担沉重的公司可能面临重新评估扩张计划的压力。

title: Luxury retailers turn to outlets for growth. Analysts say these stocks can benefit
summary: Luxury retailers are investing heavily in outlet stores to expand market reach and attract price-conscious consumers. This strategy allows high-end brands to sell excess inventory while building new customer segments. Financial analysts believe companies executing this strategy effectively could see improved stock performance.
content: Higher-end retailers are trying to drum up business by pouring money into their outlet operations and attracting more lower-end shoppers.

zh.title: 奢侈品零售商开设折扣店寻求增长 分析师看好相关股票
zh.summary: 奢侈品零售商正在大力投资奢侈品折扣店以扩大市场范围，吸引注重价格的消费者。这一策略使高端品牌能够清售过剩库存，同时开发新的客户群体。金融分析师认为有效执行这一战略的公司可能会看到股票表现的改善。

title: Top Wall Street analysts back these 3 stocks for their long-term growth potential
summary: Leading Wall Street analysts have identified three stocks positioned for strong long-term growth despite near-term market volatility. These recommendations focus on companies with sustainable competitive advantages and growth catalysts. Long-term investors are encouraged to maintain conviction in quality companies despite market fluctuations.
content: Investors with a long-term horizon should look beyond the ongoing noise and focus on stocks that are well-positioned to generate strong returns.

zh.title: 顶级华尔街分析师看好这3只股票的长期增长潜力
zh.summary: 领先的华尔街分析师已确定三只股票，尽管短期市场波动，但这些股票仍处于强劲长期增长的位置。这些建议的重点是具有可持续竞争优势和增长催化剂的公司。长期投资者被鼓励在市场波动中保持对优质公司的信念。

title: Earnings playbook: Apple and other megacaps lead busiest week of the season
summary: The second-quarter earnings season reaches its most intensive week with mega-cap companies like Apple reporting results at a pivotal moment for stock markets. These earnings reports will provide crucial insights into economic conditions and corporate profitability across major sectors. Results could significantly influence investor sentiment and market direction.
content: It's the most active week of the second-quarter earnings season, and comes at a critical juncture for the broader stock market.

zh.title: 财报季实战指南：苹果和其他大盘股领衔最忙碌的一周
zh.summary: 第二季度财报季进入最密集的一周，苹果等大型股公司在股市关键时刻报告业绩。这些财报将提供关于经济状况和各主要行业公司盈利能力的重要洞见。这些结果可能会显著影响投资者情绪和市场方向。

title: Last chance to apply for help with school costs
summary: A government assistance program offering up to £150 per student for school essentials is nearing its application deadline. The one-time payment is designed to help families manage back-to-school expenses. Eligible families should apply soon before the deadline passes.
content: The bonus scheme offers a one-off payment of up to £150 towards school essentials.

zh.title: 申请学校费用援助的最后机会
zh.summary: 一项政府援助计划向每名学生提供最高150英镑用于购买学校必需品,申请截止日期即将到来。这笔一次性付款旨在帮助家庭管理返校费用。符合条件的家庭应在截止日期前尽快申请。

title: Cocoa prices are easing. So why is chocolate still so expensive?
summary: Despite easing cocoa prices, chocolate remains expensive due to lingering effects of poor weather conditions, tariffs, and Middle East geopolitical tensions that disrupted supply chains. Chocolate manufacturers are focusing on premium products and social media trends to recover lost sales and win back price-conscious consumers.
content: Chocolate firms look to win shoppers back with premium products and social media trends after poor weather conditions, tariffs, and the Iran war hit sales.

zh.title: 可可价格下跌 巧克力为何仍然昂贵?
zh.summary: 尽管可可价格下跌，巧克力仍然昂贵，这是因为恶劣天气条件、关税和中东地缘政治紧张局势导致的持久影响破坏了供应链。巧克力制造商正专注于高端产品和社交媒体趋势，以恢复失去的销售并赢回价格敏感的消费者。

title: Primark's new 'supermarket tactic' to woo customers in online price war
summary: Primark is implementing new pricing and retail tactics to compete with ultra-cheap Chinese e-commerce retailers amid an ongoing cost of living crisis. Analysts indicate these competitive pressures are reducing customer traffic at physical stores.
content: Competition from ultra-cheap Chinese retailers and the cost of living crisis could be putting some people off shopping at the store, analysts say.

zh.title: Primark新"超市战术"在线上价格战中吸引顾客
zh.summary: Primark正在实施新的定价和零售战术，在持续的生活成本危机中与超便宜的中国电商零售商竞争。分析人士表示，这些竞争压力正在减少实体店的客流量。

title: Rental searches for pet friendly properties drop after law change
summary: Rental searches for pet-friendly properties have declined following a law change that clarified pet ownership policies. Agents report that renters are confused about whether landlord permission for pets is automatically guaranteed, leading to decreased interest in pet-friendly rental listings.
content: Agents say some renters wrongly believe permission to have a pet is guaranteed.

zh.title: 法律变化后宠物友好租赁物业的搜索量下降
zh.summary: 在澄清宠物所有权政策的法律变化后，宠物友好租赁物业的搜索量有所下降。房产经纪人报告称，租户对房东是否会自动同意养宠物感到困惑，导致对宠物友好租赁清单的关注度降低。
